hero.sub: Real numbers from the digital marketing battlefield. No agency smoke, just data on what it takes to generate leads for a pest control company.

three_k.answer: The $3,000/month agencies quote is their MANAGEMENT FEE ONLY. Ad spend is ALWAYS separate.

agency_fee.label: Agency Fee
agency_fee.desc: Strategy, campaign setup, optimization, creative, reporting. Paid to the agency for managing the machine.

ad_spend.label: Ad Spend
ad_spend.desc: The actual money that buys clicks and leads. Paid to Google and Meta, on top of the fee.

breakdown.description: The retainer. Billed on top of all ad spend

competitive.patriot_note: Patriot at $6,250/mo all-in sits in the mid-market band, but covers management AND ad spend. Agencies at that price cover the fee only, and the spend lands on top.

lead_response.headline: What about responding to leads instantly?
lead_response.body: Patriot already has Twilio SMS and voice wired into the website. Leads hit the system the moment they submit, no 5-hour Facebook delay. Facebook advertising is already producing results. Google Ads is the next front to open, and the infrastructure is ready.

notes: AD SPEND: billed by Google and Meta directly, or passed through at cost. Never bundled into the retainer.
AGENCY FEE: the management slice on top. Flat retainer or 10-20% of spend.
FACEBOOK: already operational and producing results. Next objective: Google Ads PPC.
CROSS-CHECK: FieldRoutes puts average all-in pest spend at $4,376-$7,376/mo. PestHound puts a full agency operation at $4,000-$15,000/mo.
